Note: It is the day that was just loaded onto the card that is immediately validated i.e. The card is now valid for travel for the rest of the day, but does not hold any more days on it. 

If passenger would rather not top up, and just get off the bus or buy a different ticket, they may removed the card to cancel.

cases.section_path: HMI / Screens / 7.0 Printer Errors and Events
cases.custom_steps:
**NOTE**
Euro functionality will not be fully delivered until R2.1.

The user can select an Alighting Stage. To change the currency, they can press the Alighting Stage key again this will change the currency to Euros. To change back to £, they'll press the Alighting Stage key for a third time. 

For basket mode, the user will need to follow the method above to get into Euros, then enter basket mode. This should keep the ETM in Euro mode and also unselect a selected Alighting Stage.

cases.title: 7.0.6 Main Screen - Travel Mode
cases.section_path: HMI / Screens / 7.0 Printer Errors and Events
cases.custom_steps:
**NOTE**
The Schedule Adherence Indicator will not be implemented until R2.1.

While driving, the device will change to a Travel Mode which displays the time and date to the driver to minimise distraction. This triggers from a timeout from FLU after 1 minute. Any button press takes the driver back to FLU.

Brightness will also be dimmed in Travel Mode. 

When the bus stops the driver can press the enter key or a customer can present a smartcard to restore the brightness and return to the FLU screen.

This screen also displays Schedule Adherence.

If the box is green, the operator is on time. If the box is orange, the operator is within a set parameter for early or late, and the times are +/-. If the box is red, the operator is outside of the set parameter, and the times are +/-.

Slightly late/early and very late/early screens can be found within the prototype.
